requirements.obligation: Preserve one VM81 Runtime, one admitted commit path, IDE-registered public API workflows, and bounded installer host authority distinct from Runtime authority.
Run a non-mutating capability probe and emit a precise compatibility/profile decision before installation mutation.
Implement auto, core, runtime, assistant-external, assistant-local-cpu, assistant-local-gpu, developer, android-build, container, and offline profiles with exact inclusion and exclusion sets.
Normalize POSIX, PowerShell, repository-local, portable Python, and offline commands to one installation request schema.
Maintain machine-readable dependency graphs, profile-separated manifests, locks, isolated Python environments, Node isolation, and import closure.
Provide capability-based Linux, macOS, Windows, Android/Termux, BSD/POSIX, container, and restricted-cloud adapters plus portable native artifact mapping and validation.
Classify local GPU, local CPU, external, disabled, degraded, or incompatible provider state and govern model assets without false hardware claims.
Verify source, installer, dependency, bundle, and model identities; enforce safe extraction, secure temporary files, signature/digest policy, and offline no-network behavior.
Implement staged transaction state, atomic activation, idempotence, update, rollback, repair, uninstall, and user-data preservation.
Generate canonical installation identities and append-only installation receipts without host-specific contamination of content identity.
Use least privilege, bounded timeouts/retries/polling, exclusive mutation locks, structured redacted logs, exact terminal classifications, and no indefinite waits.
Verify Pass 172 through static audit, clean installation execution, independent reconstruction, and fault/repair lanes, with redundant evidence for load-bearing claims.
Maintain requirement, dependency, platform, architecture, profile, and calibration coverage matrices, including all bound deep-scan issues.
Preserve historical defect evidence, verify current repaired state independently, and prevent superseded findings or external prototypes from becoming false current claims.
Inventory live native projects and independently verify native, Python, and Node dependency/build equivalence at each claimed boundary.
Execute provider and model calibration using real declared boundaries and classify unavailable hardware nonterminally.
Inject the mandatory fault catalog, require stable classifications, and apply minimal repair-forward corrections followed by dependency-scoped revalidation.
Reconcile executed test counts, independently verify receipt chains, reconstruct installation identity, and perform logical/full replay plus cross-platform equivalence classification.
Verify path, security, upgrade, uninstall, offline, container, Android, and public status boundaries without accepting prohibited shortcuts.
Produce repository-visible evidence, bounded CI topology, repair-forward cadence, exact verdict hierarchy, honest nonclaims, and A+ replay closure before terminal verification.
Externalize complete restart state before long-running operations and close every task as SUCCESS, FAILURE, or BLOCKED with an exact resumable next action.
